subject: Procurement & Marketplace Paths — Clarify PO timing and Private Offer interest (Orion Health)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@orionhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement paths & marketplace options (Orion Health)

Hi Liam — great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps on procurement paths so your finance team can evaluate options cleanly:

Key items we covered:
- Procurement preference: your team said "marketplace preferred if equivalent terms" but procurement needs confirmation on invoicing cadence and PO vs card timing.
- AWS Marketplace: you asked about Private Offer capabilities (consolidated invoice + metered billing).
- Paper terms: standard PO terms vs Marketplace PO time-to-execution (depends on legal review + Marketplace listing).

Proposed next steps:
1) If procurement wants Marketplace, I can loop in our Marketplace specialist and send a one-page Private Offer brief (attached).
2) If you need a PO now and want to avoid marketplace onboarding, we can accept a PO to our corporate billing (we'll need W-9 + contact for remittance).
3) For either path, please confirm the approvers and expected PO issuance timeline so we can align a pilot start date.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-audit.pdf (pricing snapshot), W-9-redwood.pdf

If helpful, I can propose two simple motion options for your CFO: (A) AWS Marketplace Private Offer — faster consolidated billing but requires Marketplace checks; (B) Direct PO — rapid start, standard invoicing. Which would you prefer I present to procurement?

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0191
www.redwood.ai

From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@orionhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@orionhealth.com, Sally.Chen <sally.chen@orionhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 15:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement paths & marketplace options (Orion Health)

Thanks Hannah — useful recap. A few clarifications from procurement side:

- Marketplace is preferred from an ops perspective, but Finance will only greenlight if the Marketplace invoice supports monthly consolidated billing and PO referencing our contract number.
- If we go direct PO, we typically need a 45-day net and a signed SOW for the pilot. Can you confirm Redwood's standard net terms and whether a short pilot SOW is OK?
- Who on your side handles AWS Private Offer setup? We'll need a contact to kick off the Marketplace qualification checklist.

I'll loop in Sally from Finance for the PO/term questions. For now, please send the Private Offer brief and a sample SOW.

Best,
Liam
Director, Procurement
Orion Health

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@orionhealth.com, sally.chen@orionhealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Materials: Private Offer brief + sample SOW and payment options

Hi Sally / Procurement team — per Liam's note, attaching a short brief on our recommended Marketplace Private Offer flow and a sample one-page pilot SOW. Highlights:

Marketplace Private Offer (recommended if Finance okays consolidated monthly billing):
- Consolidated monthly invoice with PO number on the invoice (we can pass through PO references in invoice metadata).
- Metered billing or committed monthly license — we can support either.
- AWS Private Offer setup typically takes ~2–3 weeks once the commercial terms are agreed; legal review can add time.

Direct PO route (if you need to start immediately):
- We can accept a PO to Redwood Inference, Inc.; standard net is 30 days but we can align to 45 for pilot — will need approvals.
- Required docs: W-9 (attached), standard SOC2 attestation is available on request.

Attachments: aws-private-offer-brief.pdf, SOW-draft.docx, W-9-redwood.pdf

Could you confirm: (1) preferred procurement path (Marketplace vs Direct PO), (2) expected signatory for pilot SOW, and (3) any internal deadlines we should be aware of?

Thanks,
Hannah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Materials: Private Offer brief + sample SOW and payment options

Nice recap — a few tactical suggestions before we send anything to Finance:

- Lead with AWS Marketplace Private Offer as the recommendation but include a "quick start" direct PO annex so they can start the pilot while Marketplace onboarding completes.
- Offer a 60-day pilot term on the pilot SOW with opt-out and clear usage caps — reduces procurement objections.
- For pricing, show a small marketable discount for Private Offer customers and note invoice delivery cadence (monthly consolidated).

I can draft the PO annex and a one-paragraph finance note for the SOW that explicitly calls out "PO will be accepted to Redwood Inference, Inc.; invoice will include PO reference." If Procurement asks for any special billing form, defer to karthik for billing config.

LMK and I can send the revised SOW + annex by EOD.

—Marissa
Senior Account Strategist, Redwood Inference

From: Sally Chen <sally.chen@orionhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@orionhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Materials: Private Offer brief + sample SOW and payment options

Thanks Hannah — received the brief and SOW. A couple quick notes from Finance:

1) Marketplace is preferred if invoice can include our PO number and support monthly consolidated billing. Please confirm whether Redwood can pass PO metadata into the AWS Marketplace invoice.
2) For the direct PO: 45-day net is acceptable for pilot. Please provide a copy of your standard invoice template so we can route it through our AP system.

If you can confirm the two items above, we'll expedite internal approvals and aim to have a PO out by next Wednesday.

Sally Chen
Senior Finance Manager, Orion Health
